title: Mutation
description: Represents a mutation operation on the AST

nodeId.description: The unique identifier of the target node (required for setProperty and deleteNode)

property.description: The property name to set (required for setProperty)

value.description: The value to set (required for setProperty)

parentId.description: The parent node ID (required for insertNode)

role.description: The role/relationship to the parent (required for insertNode)

node.description: The node object to insert (required for insertNode)
